No data exfiltration was observed, but the host was compromised and posed a critical risk.

rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike beacons based on packed .NET artifacts"
        author = "SOC Team"

    condition:

}

arguments.rule_content:
rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Detect {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike Beacon DLLs based on configuration and behavior"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        max_false_positives = 0.01
    strings:
        $config = { 2E 73 76 63 68 6F 73 74 5F 75 70 64 61 74 65 2E 64 6C 6C } // ".svchost_update.dll"
        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" wide ascii
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // PE header
        $config and $beacon_mutex and 
        1 of ($http_get, $http_post)
}

Incident severity downgraded to 'informational' for the encryption event. A new critical incident should be opened for the confirmed compromise on WS-FIN-042.
